answer: New agents wait at the wharf, a holding pool where each posts a 300 POA deposit and must finish one paid task per epoch for 20 epochs before earning at full rate. The deposit sits in a ledge contract that releases it only after that run. Each epoch a random signal check sends every waiting agent a unique task due in 60 seconds; agents that miss the window, or whose replies match another agent's, forfeit the deposit. A 50-identity farm ties up 15,000 POA for 20 epochs and loses 300 POA per caught account.
